//: Copy this file, fill in every REPLACE_ME value, save it OUTSIDE the repo (never commit a filled-in copy), and place it beside the API on the server as appsettings.Production.json. It is never published. The identity settings are refused at startup while still REPLACE_ME, naming the key; a missing Cors:AllowedOrigins or Repository setting stops the API at startup, naming it.

Repository.//: The OilGas repository: its people, roles, personas and module bindings. SqlServer, PostgreSql or Oracle.

Diagnostics.//: The failure store the API and the Web share (DIAG-01): every failure, under the reference its caller or viewer was given, read at the Web's /admin/failures. SqlServer, PostgreSql or Oracle; it may be the repository's own database (its migrations keep their own history table). This host owns the schema: MigrateOnStartup applies it, or run dotnet ef database update for the engine's context. The Web names the same Provider and ConnectionString.

IdentityServer.//: Audience is this API's identifier as registered under Admin > APIs on the identity server; a token for any other API is refused. AllowedClients lists the client ids this API accepts people's tokens from — the OilGas Web application's console-generated id.

Cors.//: The origins a browser may call this API from. The Web application calls it from the server, so a deployment whose only caller is the Web may list its own address.
